name: UltraDNS DNS Plugin
description: DNS-01 challenge validation provider using DigiCert UltraDNS. Implements the IDomainValidator interface to create, manage, and clean up DNS TXT records in UltraDNS-hosted zones for ACME domain validation. Authenticates via an UltraDNS account username and password (OAuth2 password grant).

dns_provider_config.Name: UltraDns_Username
dns_provider_config.Description: UltraDNS account username used for OAuth2 password-grant authentication.

dns_provider_config.Name: UltraDns_Password
dns_provider_config.Description: UltraDNS account password used for OAuth2 password-grant authentication.
